top_concerns: Overclaiming: 'transformers learn like brains' and 'genes unnecessary' do not follow from three coarse qualitative probes with no neural or behavioural newborn data
No baselines or controls (CNNs, other objectives, natural or non-wave smooth input), so specificity to retinal waves or transformers is unestablished; scrambling control is confounded

Weak or circular metrics: hand-built orientation RDM with arbitrary decay, 16-object shape/colour test that may reflect colour insensitivity, gradient-variance 'RF' ill-defined for global-attention ViTs and tested on a single stimulus; retinotopy untested
Insufficient statistical reporting (seeds, error bars, tests) and underspecified methods (loss, input rendering, layer definitions)
Limited novelty over prior retinal-wave and emergent-locality work; ViT patching and objective are inductive biases contradicting the 'no hardcoded priors' framing
